svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Move labels
svg.desc: Move labels by the drop in win probability from the mover's view, in win points: best is the top move or within 2 of it, good up to 5, inaccuracy from 5, mistake from 10, blunder from 15. A drop exactly on a cutoff takes the higher label.
